Callout.Name: Pedestrian Struck
Callout.Message: Pedestrian struck by a vehicle, driver still on scene.
Callout.Advisory: Casualty in the road, road blocked.

Script.Line: I was on the crossing. I am sure I was on the crossing.
It came from the left. I only heard it.
Somebody has my bag. My bag is over by the wall.

Callout.Patient: My leg. I cannot feel my leg properly.

Lines.Approach: Casualty in the road and the driver is standing there in shock. Two patients for you.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
